name: browser-pdf-canvas-skill
title_zh: 翻到哪页才渲染哪页的 PDF 阅读器内核
tagline_zh: 几百页 PDF 一打开就卡死、滚动时页码乱跳、Ctrl+F 搜不到正文——这套 Canvas 架构用 Inters…
tagline_en: Hundreds of pages freeze on open, page numbers jump while scrolling, Ctrl+F misses body text. This Canvas.
desc_en: Custom PDF.js HTML5 Canvas viewer architecture: lazy virtualized rendering via IntersectionObserver, elimination of ghost-scroll feedback loops, and isolated in-document text search.
why_zh: 虚拟化渲染、滚动反馈环隔离、文档内独立搜索三件事被拆成互不干扰的层，改一处不会连带崩掉另外两处。
why_en: Virtualized rendering, scroll-loop isolation, and in-document search are split into layers that don't break each other when you.
limit_zh: 只给架构和实现思路，不含打包好的组件；要你自己接 PDF.js 与构建流程。文本搜索只覆盖有文字层的 PDF。
limit_en: Architecture and implementation guidance only, no packaged component; you wire up PDF.js and your build. Search covers text-layer PDFs only—OCR.
title_en: A PDF viewer core that only renders the page you reach
